card.text: A Cepheid in the galaxy NGC 4536, 15 million parsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 17.9 days.

introduction.text: The Hubble Space Telescope found it and timed its pulsation at 17.9 days. Its galaxy's distance, 15.2 million parsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.
